title: Quantum Algorithms for Network Signal Coordination
summary: There has been increasing interest in developing efficient quantum algorithms for hard classical problems. The Network Signal Coordination (NSC) problem is one such problem known to be NP complete. We implement Grover's search algorithm to solve the NSC problem to provide quadratic speedup. We further extend the algorithm to a Robust NSC formulation and analyse its complexity under both constant and polynomial-precision robustness parameters.
